summary: The PR adds a --skip-checks option to the runserver command, which resolves the linked issue. However, there are some minor style and consistency issues.

issues.description: The new test script `test_runserver.py` uses `os._exit(0)` which is generally discouraged in favor of `sys.exit(0)`. Also, the script assumes a specific path `/testbed` which may not be portable.
The new test script `test_runserver.py` sets up Django settings manually instead of using a separate settings module, which is inconsistent with the rest of the test setup.
The new test script `test_runserver.py` prints directly to stdout, which is not ideal for automated testing environments. It should use logging or assertions instead.
The new `--skip-checks` option is added but there is no documentation update in the relevant documentation files to reflect this change.
